about: Headwaters Peruque Creek drains about 57 square miles, 64% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 850 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 510 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Peruque Creek, Sams Creek, Smith Branch and Skunk Creek. St. Charles County communities here include Wentzville, Lake St. Louis, Foristell, Dardenne Prairie and O'Fallon. Downstream, its water passes through the Peruque Creek, Cuivre Island-Mississippi River and Bolter Island-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
